answer_1.quote: We develop HICode: an LLM-based pipeline with two primary modules, one that generates data labels and one that hierarchically clusters labels...
answer_1.outputs: short textual labels for each segment and hierarchical themes derived from clustering

answer_2.quote: We calculate theme-level and segment-level metrics which are modified precision and recall scores... We report theme-level precision and recall scores on TopicGPT, LLooM, Incremental and HICode...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation by recruiting two of the original annotators of Astro to manually compare the generated themes with the human themes. We provide outputs ... and ask annotators to score each pair of gold and generated themes with 0.5 if the gold theme is partially recovered ... and 1 if the gold theme exactly matches the generated theme.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored each pair of gold and generated themes with 0.5 for partial recovery and 1 for exact match.
